text: The flake exposes `estate`: per host, the system services it runs, its capabilities and where it's hosted, read without building
why: Tend's estate and thalam (L2 Machine) read machines only from this export (repo-model; thalam's graft 01a19b0c). Capabilities are set like services: by the module that provides one where it turns it on (estate.nix adds `nix` to every host, Tenstorrent `tenstorrent`, an AMD or NVIDIA GPU driver `vulkan`, ROCm OpenCL `opencl`), using only ids in vg-paradigms' estate/capabilities.toml; no `rocm` or `cuda` since neither toolkit is installed, and no `kvm` until the vocabulary has it (graft 01a1c1db-427e to vg-paradigms). Exported sorted and distinct; an added field keeps exports.version at 1.

title: Add `kvm` to the hosts' estate capabilities once the vocabulary has it
body: Where KVM is usable: bare-metal x86 NixOS hosts with virtualization on, and vgwsl2 once Windows exposes AMD-V (its own todo). Set it in a module where KVM is turned on, not per host by hand.
